key.name: glass
key.description: The top bar, the dash, menus, dialogs, notifications and on-screen displays blur what is behind them.

key.name: lighting
key.description: A menu's edge is lit from the button that opened it, and turns warmer when the battery is low.

key.name: glass-tint
key.description: How tinted the glass is, from clear (0) to fully tinted (1).

key.name: window-glass
key.description: GTK 4 and GTK 3 app windows are 80% opaque over the same blur as Glass, sidebars included. Bars drawn apart from the window, such as Image Viewer's title bar and tab bars, stay solid, and so do fullscreen windows. Apps that draw their own window, such as Firefox, are unchanged. Apps opened afterwards pick it up.

key.name: power-on
key.description: As a menu opens, its lit edge traces out from the button that opened it. Needs Lighting.

key.name: glow
key.description: Switches that are on, checked boxes, slider fills, progress bars and default buttons glow in the accent color. In apps, it applies to those opened after a change.

key.name: glass-off-gaming
key.description: Glass and lighting turn off while GameMode runs a game (gg, ggm or gamemoderun). App windows keep their glass.

key.name: glass-off-power-saver
key.description: Glass and lighting turn off while the power mode is Power Saver. App windows keep their glass.

key.name: focus-brackets
key.description: While you use the keyboard, four corner brackets mark the focused button or menu item outside app windows. The focus ring stays.
